company: SYSTEM West Virginia University Health System
title: Associate Technical Support Analyst - Storage/Backups/Linux
location: Information Technology Center
field: -
description:
The primary duties include being the Tier 1 service provider and onsite representation for coordinated support from Tier 2 and Tier 3 analyst/engineers in Enterprise Information Systems team.
[under: CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES] - Travels independently to remote sites and communicates back to the team while working offsite (if assigned).
[under: CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES] - Use office productivity software to create and update team documents and to document network/security issues for management.
[under: CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES] - Works with Senior IRT Team to mitigate any threats as needed onsite.
[under: CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES] - Accepts on-call duties and responds with action, either by phone or on-site, as defined by department policy.
[under: CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES] - Supports network services team by assisting in maintaining server infrastructure onsite to include but not limited to Nutanix, Hyper-V, VMware, or any physical hardware as requested.
[under: CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES] - Supports healthcare applications by helping troubleshoot technical problems from the remote site for the application team. Instruct end-users on proper use of applications as requested.
[under: CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES] - Supports current industry software by recommending, installing, configuring, upgrading, troubleshooting, managing and removing such applications as Windows desktop operating systems, Microsoft Office suite, billing, accounting, clinical, ERP, anti-virus and encryption along with other programs that may be deployed or acquired.
